parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: B1: $R=8g\cos30^\circ=40\sqrt3=69.282\ldots$, resolving perpendicular to the plane. *M1: resolve parallel to the plane and attempt Newton's second law with three terms, allowing sign errors, trigonometric-function mix-up or missing $g$, otherwise dimensionally correct: $8g\sin30^\circ-F=8(2.4)$, so $F=20.8$. DM1: use $F=\mu R$ to form an equation in $\mu$ only; allow missing $g$, sign errors and consistent trigonometric-function mix-up. $R$ must be a single force component. $8g\sin30^\circ-8g\mu\cos30^\circ=8(2.4)$; allow cancellation of the 8 masses. A1: $\mu=0.300\ldots$, possibly via $20.8/(40\sqrt3)$ or $20.8/69.282\ldots$; allow exact $13\sqrt3/75$ or equivalent. Printed total: 4.
